hooks.command: bash "{{AI_DEV_KIT_PATH}}/scripts/skill-first-gate.sh" --phase stop --project "{{PROJECT_PATH}}" || { echo 'AI Dev Kit skill-first gate FAILED. Resolve blocking findings before completing.' >&2; exit 2; }

if printf '%s\n' "${TOOL_INPUT:-}" | grep -qE 'rm -rf /|rm -rf ~|DROP TABLE|DROP DATABASE|DELETE FROM.*WHERE 1|:(){ :|:& };:'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Destructive command detected by ai-dev-kit safety hook' >&2; exit 2; fi
